remarks: Proudly offered by a meticulous landlord, this beautiful unit has been recently painted and features newly finished hardwood floors on the first level. The home includes two generously sized bedrooms, one full bathroom, and a dedicated office space. The primary bedroom boasts a walk-in closet.  Enjoy a formal dining room and a fully updated kitchen equipped with new cabinets, quartz countertops, a new refrigerator, and a new stove hood. There is also an ample pantry and convenient laundry area located just off the kitchen.  The refurbished bathroom includes new floor tile, a new vanity, and a new toilet. Storage is abundant throughout the unit-with closets galore.  Located in a fantastic area close to all the amenities Stamford has to offer, and only 45 minutes from NYC, this unit is the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and style. This unit has recently been upgraded with high-efficiency equipment for both heating and hot water."
